about: Not a shot of the demo's: the whole desktop at 21:00 on the default schedule (Dark, Dome's Dark picture as the wallpaper, as the screenshots over a desktop have it), for scripts/make-reddit-pictures.py's picture of the desktop through a day. It's only recorded (scripts/make-demo.sh --record night-desktop), for the desktop with the popover closed, desktop-closed.png, and Light's wallpaper filling the display, wallpaper-light.png; its few frames of the popover aren't used. Dome is one of the wallpapers macOS downloads when it's picked, so it's a file in build/ (scripts/screenshots.sh says where Apple keeps it)
